content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fargo

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMI Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Document your work history, education, and specific project-leadership roles. Verify you meet these baseline qualifications before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP bootcamp. Attend instructor-led sessions designed to cover the PMBOK® Guide and exam domains. Our nationwide online format accommodates Fargo professionals' schedules while delivering the formal education PMI requires for your application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including your verified education and experience details. Pay the PMI exam fee at that time. PMI will review and approve your eligibility before you schedule your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to consolidate your bootcamp learning. Schedule your proctored exam through Pearson Vue. Pass the computer-based assessment to earn your PMP credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification requires renewal every three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or published contributions. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education options to help you meet PMI's renewal requirements and keep your credential active.
